title: The Final Horizon
author: Freya Eastwick
blurb: Tamsin Nystrom, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
